lessons_control.note: pre_lessons is each hunter's own sum before it read researcher_us/LESSONS.md. edge_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, which is the only thing that can tell the guidance file apart from a habit.

language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Lam Research, roughly half of Ichor's revenue (51-56% in every 10-K from FY2016 to FY2021; Lam plus Applied was 76% in FY2025), grew revenue 22% q/q in its September 2026 quarter ($6.72bn to $8.22bn). That beat its own $8.10bn guide midpoint, against Ichor's guided +12% q/q midpoint ($294.8m to $330m) and a $330.2m consensus. Lam's quarter ended Sep 27 and Ichor's about Sep 26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (Aug 3): revenue +15% q/q, non-GAAP EPS beat by ~10%, yet the stock fell 11.2% as margins and dilution disappointed (https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/semiconductors/nasdaq-ichr/ichor-holdings/news/ichor-holdings-ichr-stock-sinks-as-margin-recovery-fails-to). Feb 2026 (Q4 2025 print plus raised outlook): +32.7%. A revenue beat alone has not been paid this year.

findings.finding: Ultra Clean (UCT), Ichor's closest listed peer with the same two dominant customers, reported Q3 2026 on Oct 27. Revenue was a record $759.0m, +18% q/q, above the top of its $700-750m guide, and it guided Q4 to $800-860m (+9% q/q at the midpoint). That points to both an Ichor Q3 revenue beat and a Q4 guide able to reach the ~$355m implied bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Ichor's guidance line has moved the stock the most: +32.7% on the Feb 2026 raised outlook and -11.2% on Q2 2026, when margins and the ramp disappointed. UCT itself traded at $51.48 on Oct 27 and $49.71 (-9.12%) on Oct 30 (https://www.trivano.com/persbericht/770834-770834.html), so the peer's beat-and-raise was not held by the market.

findings.finding: On Oct 21 Lam put preliminary 2027 WFE at more than $200bn, against a mid-$150bn 2026 (about +30%), and expects about 10 new Tier-1 fabs in 2027. findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Feb 2026: a raised forward outlook took the stock +32.7%. Since then forward commentary has been sold (Aug -11.2%).

findings.finding: Chegg has beaten its own guide by wide margins two quarters running: Q2 2026 revenue $51.8m against a $49-50m guide and adj. EBITDA $9.1m against $5-6m; Q1 2026 revenue $63.3m against a $60-62m guide and EBITDA $15.5m against $11-12m. Repeating the Q2 pattern (+4.6% over midpoint) on the Q3 guide of $43-44m and $1-2m EBITDA points to roughly $45m revenue (+3% against the $43.5m consensus) and EBITDA of $3-5m against $1.5m. The consensus sits exactly on the guide midpoint.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Beats have been sold. Q2 2026 (2026-08-06) beat revenue and EBITDA and the stock fell 14.56% close to close on a weak Q3 guide. Q1 2026 (2026-05-06) beat by 3.7% on revenue and traded down 11.6% intraday on a weak Q2 guide, though the baseline closes it +10.34%. Q4 2025 (2026-02-09) closed -10.67%.

findings.finding: Management guided Skilling (Busuu + Chegg Skills) to 'double-digit growth for the year' with a stronger second half (Q4 2025 release, 2026-02-09). H1 2026 Skilling was $35.1m ($17.6m Q1 +9%, $17.5m Q2 +2%) against $33.35m in H1 2025. A +10% full year ($76.5m) needs H2 Skilling of about $41.4m against $35.3m in H2 2025, i.e. +17%, while growth decelerated to +2% in Q2. Chegg also stopped giving segment guidance in Q2. The company's one stated growth engine is likely to show a visible miss against its own target, and the Q4 guide has come in below consensus three quarters running (Q2 guide $49.5m midpoint vs $58.6m consensus; Q3 guide $43.5m vs $48.3m; Q3 EBITDA $1.5m vs $6.0m).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: A next-quarter guide below consensus has gone with -14.56% (2026-08-06) and -10.67% (2026-02-09) close to close, and an intraday -11.6% on 2026-05-06 that closed +10.34%.

findings.finding: Chegg is out of compliance with the NYSE $1 minimum price again. The notice came 2026-07-24, the six-month cure runs to about 2027-01-24, and compliance needs a month-end close and 30-trading-day average of at least $1.00. Spot is $0.707, and stockholders approved a 1-for-4 to 1-for-15 reverse split on 2026-06-12 at the board's discretion. With roughly two month-ends left and the stock needing +41%, the board must act on the split within weeks, and an announcement alongside the Q3 release is plausible.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reverse split. The first deficiency (December 2025) was cured by the price on 2026-06-01, and the board then said it would not proceed with a split 'at this time' (Barchart, 2026-06-17).

findings.finding: Third-party web traffic for Chegg (AltIndex, aggregated estimates) reads 3.32m visits in July, 3.26m in August and 4.93m in September 2026 (+51% m/m back-to-school).
